pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Luminous Moth occurs in old spruce forests, Albino Moth in Dark Forest. Its offhand antenna reveals nearby creatures after its holder is hurt in darkness. The guide repeats some behavior text; do not invent extra attacks from that duplication.
